# Templates

**Background.** What Templates are and where to find or make one.

This section is for people who make or choose Templates.

A **Template** is a page design: layout, fonts and the kinds of document it
offers. A **Configuration** adapts a Template to an organisation with a name, a
logo and colours. Both are folders of files. You can write your own.

| Page | What it covers |
|------|----------------|
| [Template catalogue](catalogue/README.md) | The Templates that ship with Outprint: a preview, a block to copy, every field, and the errors to expect. Generated from the packages. |
| [Template author guide](template-author-guide.md) | Start here to write a Template: the model, patterns, `validate`, `render`, a worked example. |
| [Reference](../reference/README.md) | The exact syntax: [Template package](../reference/template-package.md), [Template checks](../reference/template-checks.md), [Configuration package](../reference/configuration-package.md), [Standard Fields](../reference/standard-fields.md) and the [Metadata Block](../reference/metadata-block.md). |

Authors who only fill in a document read [Write](../write/README.md). Admins
who choose a Template for a Collection read [Configure](../configure/README.md).
